scope: isolated finite policy-question source evidence; not general semantic intent proof/default integration
candidate: new PolicyQuestionReadSession: only policy availability+execution tightened; state binding and reference clarification inherited unchanged

patterns.runtime_cue: 程序|服务|系统|后台|进程|网页|浏览器|短信|邮件|电话|轮询|运行条件|送达条件|通知渠道|电脑|关机|休眠|断网|下线
patterns.record_reference: 这条|那条|某条|之前设的|以前设的|编号[ \t]*[0-9]+|提醒(?:的编号|编号|#)?[ \t]*[0-9]+
patterns.record_state: 状态|有效|取消|完成|存在|已经送达|已送达|送到没有|送达了吗

decision_order: visible_source masks quoted/code spans without changing offsets
record reference AND record state => record_state_not_policy, even if runtime cue

evidence.immutable: error plus runtime matches/indexes and record-reference/state flags; bound to actual live source via issued catalogue
evidence.model_visibility: source original messages+eligible declared schemas only; no labels, evidence fields, SQL data, titles or permissions

catalogue: base eligible_complete; remove POLICY when actual finite evidence disallows; issue new live source-bound immutable catalogue with evidence and rehashed metadata; no business SELECT
execution: candidate independently recomputes actual-source policy evidence inside authorized SQLite snapshot; direct POLICY submission cannot bypass unavailable catalogue; no model-supplied authority or metadata
unchanged_safety: publish current source and latest-issued identity
no verified read => fixed no-read; model draft retained not published
clarification: existing no-unique-ID ReferenceClarification distinct from business read and validation error; extra policy evidence does not itself authorize reference clarification
execution_authority: CPU/current-software/runtime identity then separate exact frozen descriptor; protected separate after primary development pass
